_note: HELIOS's purpose, as data. Every capability names the paid product category it replaces, what those vendors charge (published list price, third-party figure, or 'not published'), the open datasets it is built from, and what open data still cannot replace. The Open Stack page, the panel strips and the exports all read this file.
thesis: Most sustainability software resells public data and open standards. HELIOS rebuilds it from open data, shows every source, and says where a paid product is still worth it.

capabilities.name: Nature risk (TNFD Locate)
capabilities.what: Every building screened against reserves, national parks, nature areas and sensitive coastal habitat; tree cover and species records per area.
capabilities.out_of_reach: IBAT's Key Biodiversity Areas and protected-area layers (commercial licence), commercial use of the IUCN Red List, monetised dependency scores.

capabilities.name: Physical climate risk
capabilities.what: Ground level against PUB's 4 m minimum platform level, distance to PUB flood-prone locations, greenery as a heat proxy, ray-cast street shade.
capabilities.out_of_reach: Hydrodynamic flood depths by return period, damage functions, insurance-grade hazard.

capabilities.name: Carbon accounting (Scope 1 & 2)
capabilities.what: Location-based Scope 2 per building from measured energy × EMA grid factor; portfolio draft disclosure with obligations, carbon tax test, taxonomy split, CSV working file.
capabilities.out_of_reach: Scope 3 supplier data; metered bills for the reporting year; Scope 1 fuel logs stay owner inputs.

capabilities.name: Taxonomy & regulatory compliance
capabilities.what: Deterministic, cited rules for the Singapore-Asia Taxonomy, Green Mark 2021, Carbon Pricing Act, EV Charging Act, vehicle schemes and the ACRA reporting roadmap — with badges on every intervention.
capabilities.out_of_reach: A legal opinion; the Gazette order with EV charger minimums.

capabilities.name: Regulatory change monitoring
capabilities.what: A local model reads new policy PDFs, drafts checkable rules with verbatim quotes, and is cross-checked against the hand-built engine before a person approves.
capabilities.out_of_reach: Coverage beyond the documents you load; human sign-off is still required.

capabilities.name: Building ESG benchmarking
capabilities.what: Measured energy intensity, Green Mark tier, certificate expiry and peer rank by building type for every BCA-listed building.
capabilities.out_of_reach: Buildings BCA does not publish; water and waste.

capabilities.name: Rooftop solar feasibility
capabilities.what: Yield, payback, CO₂ and the Green Mark effect for any of 123,714 roofs.
capabilities.out_of_reach: LiDAR shading, panel layout, bankable yield reports.

capabilities.name: Carbon price scenarios
capabilities.what: The tax path under the Act and the stated S$50–80 range: facility bills, carbon cost inside electricity, and whether a plan pays for itself on carbon.

capabilities.name: Transport demand modelling
capabilities.what: Calibrated agent mode choice on real fare-card corridors; interventions re-simulated 2026–2036 with cost per tonne, heat and equity.
capabilities.out_of_reach: Island-wide runs need an LTA DataMall key (built for Jurong East today).

capabilities.name: Resident sentiment panels
capabilities.what: Census-sampled synthetic residents voiced by a local model, with stated-vs-modelled gap checks.
capabilities.out_of_reach: Real people. Synthetic panels inform consultation; they don't replace it.

ura_mp25_nature.name: URA Master Plan 2025 nature reserve, national park and nature area boundary

gbif.name: GBIF occurrence records
gbif.licence: CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-NC per record; IUCN categories non-commercial

sso_law.name: Singapore Statutes Online (Carbon Pricing Act, EV Charging Act)

lta_datamall.name: LTA DataMall (fare-card OD, bus stops, stations)

moats.name: Licensed data
moats.why: IBAT's biodiversity layers, commercial IUCN use and proprietary supplier emissions are paid for a reason.

moats.name: Assurance
moats.why: Listed companies need external limited assurance of Scope 1 & 2 from FY2029. HELIOS produces the working file the assurer tests.

moats.name: Liability
moats.why: Buyers pay partly for accountability. HELIOS answers with a trail anyone can re-run: clause, page, dataset, test.

moats.name: Scope 3 depth
moats.why: Supplier surveys, spend data and sector factors aren't public in Singapore.

moats.name: Engineering-grade hazard
moats.why: Return-period flood depths need hydrodynamic modelling, not a surface model and a list of streets.
